paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Stellar (red-giant tip) bound on axion-electron coupling g_ae. Best limits: NGC 4258 g_ae<1.6e-13 and omega Centauri g_ae<1.3e-13 (95% CL). These are mass-independent bounds for light axions (m_a << keV); mass set nominally to 1 eV as placeholder. Table I also gives 68% CL bounds (g13=0.79, 0.81, 0.62, 0.64).
